idea-plugin.name: GenericUI Project Creator & Target Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Official IntelliJ IDEA plugin for creating and managing GenericUI Kotlin Multiplatform projects.
  • New GenericUI Project Wizard: Interactive checkboxes for selecting target backends (windows, macos, gtk, qt, swing, android, ios, web) with quick presets (All Except Swing, Desktop Only (No Swing), Mobile Only, Select All).
  • 11 First-Party Extension Modules: Select gpu, imageProcessing, canvas2d, canvas3d, media, webView, codeEditor, aiChat, threeJs, box2d, and box3d with automatic transitive dependency resolution.
  • Manage GenericUI Targets & Extensions: Inspect and update an existing project's build.gradle.kts target backends and extension modules in-place via checkboxes.
